debt: READ THIS BEFORE EDITING THE FILE. The Rust lint fails loudly instead (`baseline-unreadable`), and the file is one object again. Keyed by file, not by citation, so editing a packet above a stale reference does not 'un-baseline' it. The map keys are the ones worth acting on: `ORIENTATION.md`, `MAP-engine.md` and `MAP-services.md` are the pages an agent reads first, and they still point at the TypeScript tree — re-pointing them at `rust/` is ordinary work, not history rewriting.
